parameters.jsCode:
const items = $input.all();
const result = [];

const HARD_REJECT = [
  /\bus[\s-]only\b/i,
  /\busa[\s-]only\b/i,
  /\bunited states only\b/i,
  /\bcanada only\b/i,
  /\buk only\b/i,
  /\bunited kingdom only\b/i,
  /\beu only\b/i,
  /\beurope only\b/i,
  /\baustralia only\b/i,
  /\bnew zealand only\b/i,
  /\bmust be based in\b/i,
  /\bmust live in\b/i,
  /\bmust reside in\b/i,
  /\bmust be located in\b/i,
  /\bauthorized to work in the (us|uk|eu|canada|australia)\b/i,
  /\bwork authorization in\b/i,
  /\blocal work permit required\b/i,
  /\bonly (us|us-based|american|us citizens|us residents)\b/i,
  /\brequires? (us|eu|uk|canadian|australian) (work authorization|work permit|citizenship|residency)\b/i,
  /\bonsite\b/i,
  /\bon-site\b/i,
  /\bin-office\b/i,
  /\bhybrid[\s,-](work|role|position)\b/i,
  /\boffice required\b/i,
  /\bremote within (us|usa|uk|eu|canada|australia|europe)\b/i,
  /\bfixed (us|est|pst|cet|gmt) hours\b/i,
  /\bstrict 9.?to.?5\b/i,
  /\bdaily live calls required\b/i,
  /\bmust overlap (full|entire) (business|working) day\b/i
];

for (const item of items) {
  const combined = `${item.json.description || ''} ${item.json.location_text || ''} ${item.json.job_title || ''}`.toLowerCase();
  const shouldReject = HARD_REJECT.some(p => p.test(combined));
  if (!shouldReject) {
    result.push(item);
  }
}

return result;

parameters.body:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', max_tokens: 400, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: `You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule:
Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do not pass the job only because it says "remote."

Reject the job if it requires the worker to live in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan.
Reject the job if it requires local work authorization outside Taiwan.
Reject the job if it is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only.
Reject the job if it requires fixed working hours that would force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan.

Keep the job only if one of these is true:
- The job says worldwide remote.
- The job says work from anywhere.
- The job says global remote.
- The job says APAC remote.
- The job allows international contractors.
- The job accepts people based anywhere.
- The company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement.

Return JSON only (no markdown, no explanation, only the raw JSON object):
{"taiwan_eligible": "yes/no/unclear", "reason": "short reason", "location_risk": "low/medium/high", "timezone_risk": "low/medium/high", "contractor_possible": "yes/no/unclear", "decision": "keep/reject/manual_check"}

Job title: ${$json.job_title}
Company: ${$json.company}
Location text: ${$json.location_text}

Job post (first 2000 chars):
${($json.description || '').substring(0, 2000)}` }] }) }}
